name: devbrew
description: DevBrew — Brewing better dev tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: quality-gates
plugins.description: Checks a change before you ship it: one /quality-gates:quality-pipeline run reviews the diff from several independent angles, runs the tests whose behavior changed, can walk the running app with your approval, and gives one verdict. When the branch has an open PR, it posts that verdict with a plain-language summary as one new comment.

plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: Sets up git workflow rules and a project charter through a short interview, writes them as AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md docs that agents read, and adds a hook that checks branch names and commit messages.

plugins.name: spec-distill
plugins.description: Turns a rough request into a ready-to-plan design: a short interview (with web research and a devil's-advocate check) writes a brief for brainstorming, and each design doc gets an independent reviewer that cannot edit it.

plugins.name: plugin-audit
plugins.description: Audits one devbrew plugin without changing it: six read-only reviewers look for gaps, a second pass tries to disprove each one, an optional codex audit adds another model's view, and you get a ranked report of the gaps that hold up. Run /plugin-audit:plugin-audit <name>.
